module_summary: Dual-clock AXI-stream FIFO with width conversion: an optional axis_adapter upsizes before or downsizes after an axis_async_fifo instance, otherwise wires bypass straight through.

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Input stream payload on s_clk domain, fed into pre-FIFO width adapter or bypass.

anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Input stream valid qualifying s_axis_tdata beats.

anchors.name: s_axis_tready
anchors.why: Input backpressure, driven from FIFO write-side ready via bypass or adapter.

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Output stream payload on m_clk domain from FIFO or downsizing adapter.

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output valid driven by FIFO read side (post_fifo_axis_tvalid).

anchors.name: m_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream ready that pops the FIFO through post_fifo_axis_tready.

anchors.name: s_axis_tlast
anchors.why: Frame boundary marker on input stream, used for frame FIFO modes.

anchors.name: m_axis_tlast
anchors.why: Frame boundary marker on output stream.

anchors.name: pre_fifo_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Width-adapted stream valid entering the async FIFO write port.

anchors.name: pre_fifo_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Width-adapted data entering the async FIFO write side.

anchors.name: post_fifo_axis_tdata
anchors.why: FIFO read-side data in m_clk domain before optional downsizing.

anchors.name: post_fifo_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: FIFO read-side valid feeding output adapter or m_axis_tvalid.

anchors.name: s_status_depth
anchors.why: FIFO occupancy reported in input clock domain.

anchors.name: m_status_depth
anchors.why: FIFO occupancy reported in output clock domain.

anchors.name: s_pause_req
anchors.why: Requests FIFO pause on input side; acknowledged by s_pause_ack.

anchors.name: m_pause_req
anchors.why: Requests FIFO pause on output side; acknowledged by m_pause_ack.

groups.name: Input width adapter / bypass
groups.description: Upsizes s_clk input stream before FIFO or passes it straight through.

groups.name: Async FIFO core
groups.description: axis_async_fifo crossing s_clk to m_clk with pause and status reporting.

groups.name: Output width adapter / bypass
groups.description: Downsizes FIFO output stream in m_clk domain or bypasses to m_axis.
